deck.title: MigrateMe — move your content anywhere, safely

props.title: MigrateMe — move your content ==anywhere, safely==.
props.subtitle: An AI-assisted, dry-run-first CMS migration toolkit.

slides.notes: Hook: everyone has a CMS they want to leave. MigrateMe makes leaving safe — preview first, write second.

left.label: Today
left.title: One-shot scripts
points: A script you run once and pray
No preview of what you'll get
No going back once it writes

right.label: Should be
right.title: Dry-run first
points: See the plan before anything changes
Only write when you trust the result

slides.notes: The pain is universal: exports are proprietary and migrations are blind. Land the gap between the two columns.

items.title: Plan
items.body: Map every field before anything moves

items.title: Migrate
items.body: Write for real, only when you're ready

items.title: Validate
items.body: Check every item made it across intact

slides.notes: Four verbs. Everything runs locally — mappings and risk reports come before any write.

props.caption: items migrated and validated from a real WordPress WXR export
props.foot: Proven on a live export — not a demo

slides.notes: First shipping route: WordPress WXR to Markdown/MDX. 44 items in, 44 out, all validated.

props.label: Where it's going
props.text: One canonical format. Every source parses into it, every destination renders from it — and your preview lives at from.wp.sandbox.migrateme.tech.

slides.notes: The vision: anything-to-anything. N sources + M destinations become N + M parsers instead of N times M scripts.
